parole.significato: A mutton or lamb soup, popular among the peoples of the Caucasus.
A series of Azerbaijani food: qiymə-çığırtma, çığırtma plov, toyuq çığırtması etc.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Azerbaijani çığırtma, from Azerbaijani çığırtmaq (“to cause somebody to cry, to cause somebody to shout, to cause somebody to scream”). Cognate with English chikhirtma.

parole.significato: A plucked string musical instrument originating from Azerbaijan, related to the chunguri and chungur.
A traditional Azerbaijani dish of dumplings filled with ground meat and condiments.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Azerbaijani düşbərə. Doublet of beshbarmak and chuchvara.

parole.significato: A genre that combines mugham with jazz.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Azerbaijani caz-muğam or via Russian джаз-мугам (džaz-mugam). Coined by Azerbaijani jazz pianist and composer Vaqif Mustafazadə.

parole.significato: A singer of mugham or traditional Azerbaijani music; a mugham vocalist
parole.testo: From Azerbaijani xanəndə, itself from Persian خْوَانَنْدَه (xwānanda).

parole.significato: The basic unit of currency for Azerbaijan; symbol ₼; subdivided into 100 qapik.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Azerbaijani manat and Turkmen manat, both from Russian моне́та (monéta), from Polish moneta, from Latin monēta. Doublet of money and mint.

parole.significato: An Azerbaijani literary tradition involving unaccompanied songs improvised to a beat.
A musical composition of Azerbaijan in a complex form that blends classical poetry and musical improvisation.
parole.testo: From Azerbaijani muğam. Doublet of maqam, muqam, and makam.

parole.testo: From Azerbaijani papaq. Mediated by Russian папа́ха (papáxa), папа́х (papáx).

parole.significato: An Azerbaijani soup made with mutton and vegetables in individual crocks with a glazed interior.
parole.testo: From Azerbaijani piti, to which compare Armenian պուտուկ (putuk).

parole.significato: A member of the Qajar tribe.
parole.testo: Ultimately from Azerbaijani Qacar (“Qajar (member of the Qajar tribe)”).

parole.significato: A unit of currency equivalent to a hundredth of an Azerbaijani manat.
parole.testo: From Azerbaijani qəpik. Doublet of kapeek, kopeika, kopek, and kopiyka.

parole.significato: A member of the Turkmen tribes who formed the basis of the military power of the Safavids.
